keyFacts: HEX is RGB written in base-16: #RRGGBB, where each pair is one channel from 00 to FF (0-255).
RGB mixes Red, Green and Blue light - the native language of screens.
HSL describes Hue (0-360°), Saturation (0-100%) and Lightness (0-100%) - closer to how humans think about colour.
HSL makes it easy to create shades: keep H and S fixed, move L up for lighter, down for darker.
The same HEX looks slightly different on different screens because displays are calibrated differently.
howTo: Stay on the HEX tab and type a colour code like #4F46E5 or the shorthand #F0A.
RGB and HSL values appear instantly with a live preview swatch.
Switch to the RGB tab and type three values (0-255) to convert the other way.
Invalid HEX shows a warning instead of silently guessing.
color-converter.formula:
HEX → RGB: split into pairs, each pair is base-16 (e.g. 4F₁₆ = 4×16 + 15 = 79).
RGB → HSL: max/min of the three channels give Lightness = (max+min)/2; Saturation from the spread; Hue from which channel is max.
Example: #4F46E5 → R=79, G=70, B=229 → H=243°, S=75%, L=59%.
benefits: Two-way conversion: HEX to RGB/HSL and RGB back to HEX in one tool.
Live preview swatch removes all doubt about what the code looks like.
3-digit shorthand accepted, so pasted snippets from CSS just work.
HSL output helps designers build consistent colour palettes.
limitations: Screens only - print (CMYK) conversion is not covered.
No alpha/opacity channel; use 8-digit HEX or RGBA in your code for transparency.
Colour appearance still varies between displays.

faqs.q: How do I convert HEX to RGB?
faqs.a: Split the HEX into three pairs and convert each from base-16 to decimal. For #4F46E5: 4F = 79, 46 = 70, E5 = 229, giving rgb(79, 70, 229). This tool does it instantly.

faqs.q: What is the difference between RGB and HSL?
faqs.a: RGB describes how much red, green and blue light to mix - great for machines. HSL describes hue (the colour angle), saturation (vividness) and lightness - great for humans picking shades and building palettes.

faqs.q: What does the # mean in a HEX colour?
faqs.a: It is just a marker meaning "what follows is hexadecimal". In CSS, #4F46E5 and the function form rgb(79,70,229) describe the exact same colour.
Yes. #F0A is shorthand for #FF00AA - each digit is doubled. This tool accepts both forms.

faqs.q: Why do my colours look different on another screen?
faqs.a: Displays differ in calibration, brightness and colour gamut. HEX/RGB values are exact numbers, but each screen renders them slightly differently - designers calibrate monitors to minimize this.

faqs.q: How do I make a lighter or darker shade?
faqs.a: Use the HSL values: keep hue and saturation the same and raise lightness for a lighter shade, lower it for darker. For #4F46E5 (L=59%), try L=75% for light and L=40% for dark.

labels.invalidHex: Not a valid HEX code. Use 3 or 6 hex digits, e.g. #F0A or #4F46E5.
